count_basis: Direct cut-edge and coarse pencilled-cell geometry; no divisibility or rotation coverage calculation.
grid_measurement: Axis-aligned native boxes approximate the slightly warped lattice; irregular paper edges/curl produce local boundary variation up to approximately 20 pixels. Membership comes from native physical edges, not the bounding box alone.
coarse_vs_fine: Coarse pitch about 140-148 native pixels; visible underlying/finer ruling about half that pitch. Adjacent fine squares are not separate stencil cells.
centre: Even eight by eight coarse lattice has no single centre cell; no centre rule introduced.
orientation: Source image as photographed. Top I-like, left two-stroke/II-like, bottom III-like marks; no secure dark right IV mark observed. No operational rotation sequence, flip or hole-scan inferred.
